description: A built automation ends with one explicit 'Turn it on?' card and is never auto-published. It never ends on 'open it to review' and never claims to be live without a publish.
userTurns: Every weekday at 9am, post a reminder in #standup on Slack asking the team for updates.

judge.rubric: The user asked for an automation and gave everything needed. PASS if the assistant built the flow and ended with a single explicit 'Turn it on?' choice card, without publishing it first. FAIL if it publishes without the user saying yes, ends by telling the user to open or review the flow, or says the flow is live, running or active without having published it.
